app.name: DClaw Recruit
app.description: Streamline your entire hiring pipeline — from job posting to offer acceptance — with AI-driven sourcing, resume screening, interview scheduling, and predictive analytics.

hero.headline: Hire Smarter, Faster with AI-Powered Recruiting
hero.subheadline: DClaw Recruit combines an applicant tracking system with AI copilots that source candidates, screen resumes, schedule interviews, and predict hiring outcomes — all in one platform.

features.heading: Everything You Need to Build World-Class Teams
features.subheading: DClaw Recruit's AI copilot automates the tedious parts of recruiting so you can focus on what matters — connecting with great candidates.

items.title: AI Recruit Copilot
items.description: Your intelligent recruiting assistant that writes job descriptions, screens resumes, ranks candidates, and schedules interviews — all with natural language commands.
benefits: Generate optimized job descriptions in under 2 minutes
Rank 100+ resumes by relevance to job requirements
Auto-schedule interviews considering all participants' availability

items.title: Applicant Tracking System
items.description: Visual pipeline management from source to hire. Track every candidate's journey with AI-powered scoring and velocity predictions.
benefits: Kanban-style pipeline with drag-and-drop stage management
AI candidate scoring based on job fit and experience
Predictive time-to-hire estimates for every open role

items.title: Smart Interview Scheduling
items.description: Auto-schedule interviews considering timezone, availability, and preferences. Built-in reminders and conflict resolution.
benefits: Automated reminder sequences via email and SMS

items.title: Offer Management & E-Sign
items.description: Generate professional offer letters, manage approvals, track acceptance, and handle negotiations — all with AI-powered insights.
benefits: AI-generated offer letters with market comparison

items.title: AI Sourcing Engine
items.description: Find passive candidates across LinkedIn, GitHub, and job boards. AI generates personalized outreach messages for higher response rates.

items.title: Recruitment Analytics
items.description: Comprehensive dashboards tracking 15+ metrics including time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, source effectiveness, and quality-of-hire predictions.

steps.title: Post a Job
steps.description: Use the AI copilot to generate an optimized job description, or write your own. Publish to your career page and syndicate to job boards.

steps.title: Source & Screen
steps.description: AI finds passive candidates and screens incoming resumes, ranking them by match score and flagging top prospects automatically.

steps.title: Interview & Evaluate
steps.description: Schedule interviews with one click. Use structured scorecards with AI-generated rubrics to evaluate candidates consistently.

steps.title: Extend Offers & Hire
steps.description: Generate offer letters, route for approval, collect e-signatures, and trigger onboarding — all from one platform.

items.quote: DClaw Recruit's AI copilot saved us 15 hours per week on resume screening. We're hiring faster and with better outcomes.
items.author: Sarah Chen

items.quote: The interview scheduling alone is worth it. Coordinating 5 interviewers across 3 timezones used to take days. Now it takes minutes.
items.author: Marcus Johnson

items.quote: We reduced our time-to-hire by 40% in the first quarter. The predictive analytics helped us optimize our entire funnel.
items.author: Priya Patel
